scope: The Power to Overcome Awoken Skill — Future Saga Chapter 4 provenance and staged mechanics

records.name: The Power to Overcome
evidence: The maintained canonical Awoken record identifies The Power to Overcome as a universal CaC Awoken Skill tied to Future Saga Chapter 4 progression.
The maintained repository source list cites Bandai Namco's Future Saga Chapter 4 availability announcement as the official DLC provenance.

Current 2026 Xenoverse 2-specific guidance states that the skill is exclusive to Future Saga Chapter 4 and unlocks after completing the Chapter 4 final story mission, Quest No. 31 — Ultimate All-Out Showdown.

The current guidance documents two stages: the initial Power to Overcome state and a second-stage unleashed state that temporarily provides extreme Ki recovery while consuming HP, followed by a cooldown.

promoted_fields.unlock_method: Complete Future Saga Chapter 4 story progression through Quest No. 31 — Ultimate All-Out Showdown.
promoted_fields.second_stage_resource_behavior: Temporary extreme Ki recovery while consuming HP, followed by a cooldown.

limits: The repository does not independently promote an exact HP-drain rate, exact Ki-recovery amount, exact cooldown duration, damage modifiers, frame data, or hitbox data from this batch.
The exact internal trigger timing and version-sensitive numerical combat values remain unresolved.
No additional prerequisite beyond the DLC/story progression is inferred from this batch.

evidence_boundary: This batch strengthens the existing Awoken provenance and two-stage behavior boundary for The Power to Overcome without inventing version-sensitive combat numbers or changing canonical relationship identities.
